Example: BERKSON
----------------

![](image/berkson.jpg)

***Joseph Berkson*** (1899-1982) - American physicist, physician and statistician.

### Berkson bias/paradox

Collider‑conditioning selection bias in hospital‑based studies where restricting the sample to hospitalized patients artificially induces a spurious inverse association between an exposure and the outcome, or a spurious positive association between two unrelated diseases, whenever the exposure, the outcome, or both independently influence the probability of hospital admission.
